app.name: Derech Kohanim
app.tagline: Navigation that knows what to keep away from

onboarding.intro: Live turn by turn navigation that respects the areas forbidden to kohanim, and verifies every route before showing it.
onboarding.stringencyIntro: Everything else follows from this choice. You can change it any time in settings.

promise.verified: Every route is checked on the server against the zone layers, not just trusted from the routing provider.
promise.honest: When no clean route exists you are told before departure, not halfway there.
promise.notRabbi: This is not a substitute for halachic guidance. The zone data comes from the association.

onboarding.termsAccept: I have read and accept the terms of use
onboarding.mustAccept: You must accept the terms to continue

auth.googleUnavailable: Google sign in is not configured in this environment
auth.guestNote: Guests get full navigation. An account keeps your places, preferences and history.
auth.termsNote: Creating an account accepts the terms of use
